role: Independent reproduction of an already public mechanical-copy claim, not a blind translation test.
target: Concatenate the two numeric parts of the2009Chayenne answer from the pinned inventory. Withhold published split from split-search function. English question/comments/emoticons never become plaintext labels.
library: Primary existing68discovery books; sensitivity all70. Search raw strings separately inside each book, never across book ends.
candidate_family: All exact two-piece raw copy covers, each part nonempty and fully occurring inside a source book. Enumerate every cut1..N-1, no fitted minimum threshold. Flag pieces both>=12for long-fragment interpretation.
witnesses: Retain all book/offset witnesses. Count distinct cut positions separately from address combinations. Copied books are not independent observations.
boundary_sensitivity: For surviving raw cuts, test source endpoints under every compatible imported-code alignment and list distinct inherited numeric-code sequences. No English labels and no selected omitted-zero pattern.

controls.copy_sampling: Uniform over valid(book,start)positions separately for the two fixed lengths. Search cut without telling algorithm the generated cut. Report true-cut inclusion and uniqueness, not English recovery. No parameter retuning.

interpretation: A recoverable copy seam can explain a source boundary without English semantics. Fragment reuse prevents treating this as independent unseen semantic content. Source attribution and publication date are not authenticated game-capture dates.
